title: On Decreasing by half in three years
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：decrease　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decrease 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the gardener ① decreased by half in three years in the rain, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② decreases by half in three years without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ decrease by half in three years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ decreased by half in three years before — a line in the notebook for April 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Decreasing by half in three years in the rain, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ decrease the cost of every load without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Decrease the cost of every load at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ decreases the cost of every load in the rain every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ decreased by half in three years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To decrease by half in three years, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody decreases by half in three years without complaint again and somebody must decrease by half in three years in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 减少（一般过去式 decreased by half in three years：1978 年园丁头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 减少（一般现在 decreases by half in three years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 减少（不定式 to decrease by half in three years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 减少（过去完成时 had decreased by half in three years：1972 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 减少（动名词 decreasing by half in three years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使下降（decrease the cost of every load：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使下降让每一趟的花费降下来）
G. v. 使下降（decrease the cost of every load：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 减少（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 decreases the cost of every load，而母亲又一次 decreased by half in three years）

items.q: decreased by half in three years
decreases by half in three years
to decrease by half in three years
decreased by half in three years before
decreasing by half in three years
decrease the cost of every load without complaint
decrease the cost of every load at once
decreases the cost of every load in the rain
decreased by half in three years again
to decrease by half in three years

answers.why: decrease 意为“减少”，1978 年园丁淋着雨减少三年里减少一半，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 decreased。
decrease 意为“减少”，自那以后园丁毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 decreases。
decrease 意为“减少”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯减少三年里减少一半”，此处为不定式 to decrease by half in three years。
decrease 意为“减少”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人减少过，故用过去完成时 had decreased。
decrease 意为“减少”，园丁说“减少三年里减少一半这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 decreasing by half in three years 作主语。
decrease 意为“使下降”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使下降让每一趟的花费降下来”，should ever 之后用原形 decrease the cost of every load。
decrease 意为“使下降”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使下降让每一趟的花费降下来（decrease the cost of every load at once），以后再也不要提起。
decrease 意为“减少”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例使下降让每一趟的花费降下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 decreases。
decrease 意为“减少”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨减少三年里减少一半，用一般过去式 decreased 叙述。
decrease 意为“减少”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要减少三年里减少一半，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 decrease 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the gardener decreased by half in three years in the rain, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener decreases by half in three years without complaint whenever the garden asks.
Decreasing by half in three years in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever decrease the cost of every load without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden decreases the cost of every load in the rain every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother decreased by half in three years again, and the garden remembered that half.
